# Dodatni Memcheck primeri {#sec-memcheck-dodatni-primeri}

Ovaj direktorijum sadrži dodatne parove programa za kratke laboratorijske vežbe. Svaki par ima lošu verziju i popravljenu verziju. Cilj je da se isti test ponovi nad obe verzije i da se razlikuju stvarne greške od poruka koje su posledica ranije greške.

``` bash
$ make
$ valgrind --leak-check=full ./01_invalid_read.out
$ valgrind --leak-check=full ./01_invalid_read_fixed.out
```

- `01_invalid_read.c`: čitanje jednog bajta van alociranog bloka; očekuje se `Invalid read`.

- `02_invalid_write.c`: upis nul karaktera van alociranog bloka; očekuje se `Invalid write`.

- `03_watch_your_pointers.c`: izgubljen rezultat `realloc`; očekuju se greške pri oslobađanju i curenje.

- `04_test01.cpp`: prekoračenje niza i pogrešno oslobađanje; očekuju se `Invalid write` i `Mismatched free/delete`.

- `05_test02.cpp`: neinicijalizovani elementi niza; očekuje se prijava za `uninitialised`.

# Neispravno čitanje {#sec-memcheck-invalid-read-misc}

``` c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

int main() {
    char *destination = calloc(27, sizeof(char));
    char *source = malloc(26 * sizeof(char));

    for (int i = 0; i < 27; i++) {
        *(destination + i) = *(source + i);
    }

    free(destination);
    free(source);
    return 0;
}
```

# Neispravan upis {#sec-memcheck-invalid-write-misc}

``` c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

int main() {
    char *alphabet = calloc(26, sizeof(char));

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        *(alphabet + i) = 'A' + i;
    }
    *(alphabet + 26) = '\0';

    free(alphabet);
    return 0;
}
```

# Sačuvati rezultat realokacije {#sec-memcheck-realloc-misc}

``` c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

struct _List {
    int *data;
    int length;
};
typedef struct _List List;

List *resizeArray(List *array) {
    int *dPtr = array->data;
    dPtr = realloc(dPtr, 15 * sizeof(int));
    return array;
}

int main() {
    List *array = calloc(1, sizeof(List));
    array->data = calloc(10, sizeof(int));
    array = resizeArray(array);

    free(array->data);
    free(array);
    return 0;
}
```

``` c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

struct _List {
    int *data;
    int length;
};
typedef struct _List List;

List *resizeArray(List *array) {
    int *dPtr = array->data;
    dPtr = realloc(dPtr, 15 * sizeof(int));
    array->data = dPtr;
    return array;
}

int main() {
    List *array = calloc(1, sizeof(List));
    array->data = calloc(10, sizeof(int));
    array = resizeArray(array);

    free(array->data);
    free(array);
    return 0;
}
```

# C++ niz i oslobađanje memorije {#sec-memcheck-cpp-array-misc}

``` cpp
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

int main();
void f(int n);

int main()
{
    int n = 10;

    cout << "\n";
    cout << "TEST01\n";
    cout << "  C++ version.\n";
    cout << "  A sample code for analysis by VALGRIND.\n";

    f(n);
    //
    //  Terminate.
    //
    cout << "\n";
    cout << "TEST01\n";
    cout << "  Normal end of execution.\n";

    return 0;
}

void f(int n)
{
    int i;
    int *x;

    x = (int *)malloc(n * sizeof(int));

    x[0] = 1;
    cout << "  " << 0 << "  " << x[0] << "\n";

    x[1] = 1;
    cout << "  " << 1 << "  " << x[1] << "\n";

    for (i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        x[i] = x[i - 1] + x[i - 2];
        cout << "  " << i << "  " << x[i] << "\n";
    }

    delete[] x;

    return;
}
```


# Neinicijalizovani elementi niza {#sec-memcheck-uninitialized-array-misc}

``` cpp
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

void junk_data();
int main();

int main()
{
    cout << "\n";
    cout << "TEST02:\n";
    cout << "  C++ version\n";
    cout << "  A sample code for analysis by VALGRIND.\n";

    junk_data();
    //
    //  Terminate.
    //
    cout << "\n";
    cout << "TEST02\n";
    cout << "  Normal end of execution.\n";

    return 0;
}

void junk_data()
{
    int i;
    int *x;

    x = new int[10];

    for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        x[i] = i;
    }

    x[2] = x[7];
    x[5] = x[6];

    for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        x[i] = 2 * x[i];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        cout << "  " << i << "  " << x[i] << "\n";
    }

    delete[] x;

    return;
}
```

``` cpp
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

void junk_data();
int main();

int main()
{
    cout << "\n";
    cout << "TEST02:\n";
    cout << "  C++ version\n";
    cout << "  A sample code for analysis by VALGRIND.\n";

    junk_data();
    //
    //  Terminate.
    //
    cout << "\n";
    cout << "TEST02\n";
    cout << "  Normal end of execution.\n";

    return 0;
}

void junk_data()
{
    int i;
    int *x;

    x = new int[10];

    for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        x[i] = i;
    }

    x[2] = x[7];
    x[5] = x[6];

    for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        x[i] = 2 * x[i / 2];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        cout << "  " << i << "  " << x[i] << "\n";
    }

    delete[] x;

    return;
}
```
